name: Thubten Shedrup Ling Monastery
reason: Too thin: a monks' residence near Bendigo whose public teachings and retreats are run by Atisha Centre on the same land (tslmonastery.au/retreats-on-site, 13 Nov 2026); its own items are only a men-only monastic pre-ordination course (next intake Feb 2028), an expression-of-interest lamrim retreat and a Friends sign-up. The site (tslmonastery.org now redirects to www.tslmonastery.au) is on Wix, so its photos sit on static.wixstatic.com, which refuses our robots.txt request, and no YouTube channel is linked. Possible lead instead: Atisha Centre (not researched).
